title: Why GTA 6 Took 13 Years
description:
GTA 5 came out in 2013. GTA 6 came out in 2026. So what took Rockstar 13 years?

GTA 6 made $3.79 billion on day one, the biggest launch in entertainment history. But getting there took a money machine that wouldn't stop, a cowboy detour, a crunch reckoning, the exit of the people who created GTA, a pandemic, a teenage hacker in a hotel room, and two last-minute delays. Here are the 8 reasons GTA 6 took so long.

In this video:
• How GTA 5 and GTA Online became too profitable to replace
• Why Red Dead Redemption 2 came first
• The '100-hour weeks' controversy and how Rockstar changed
• The 2022 leak: a teenager, a hotel room and a Fire Stick
• Why the release slipped twice, and what it paid off
